1 Project

2 Levels

Only one level is loaded at a time, so a big game fits in the computer's memory.

How many levels? 10

Moving to the next level: put this block at the end of a level, after the loading cutscene:

console log @next

Or jump to a particular level with @level level4. Search the toolbox for “console log” to find the block.

3 Play together

4 Copying blocks from arcade.makecode.com

The two websites cannot share copied blocks by themselves. Drag these two buttons onto your bookmarks bar, once:

Copy for Arcade Collab Paste from Arcade Collab

Into Arcade Collab: on arcade.makecode.com click a block, press Ctrl+C, then click the Copy for Arcade Collab bookmark. Here, click in the editor and press Ctrl+V.

The other way: press Ctrl+C on blocks here, then on arcade.makecode.com click the Paste from Arcade Collab bookmark and press Ctrl+V.
